adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, update logic was changed to fan out across *all* calendar references (`calendarReference = ...filter(...)` and `for (const reference of calendarReference) { ... updateEvent(...) }`). However, the merge-reschedule cleanup still deletes only a single old calendar event via `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` (i.e., first match only). With multiple calendar references now possible, this will leave other old calendar events undeleted (orphaned) on additional hosts/calendars.
